services.name: Lap Swim
services.desc: Spare your joints and get an impactful cardiovascular workout by lap swimming! The benefits are immense. To help maintain a safe and nurturing environment, we encourage lane sharing and circle swimming if more than one person is using a lane. This will create a good flow and allow you to have your own space for clean strokes. We also provide equipment to help vary the challenge and make lap swimming more enjoyable. This is non-stop swimming for YMCA Members who are 12 years of age and older. Children under 12 years of age must be accompanied by an adult.
